latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Diagnose hidden dysfunction in product processes, even when Agile frameworks are followed.

- Identifies 10 structural root causes for why features may ship on time but fail to deliver value or be adopted.
- Helps product leaders, teams, and consultants quickly pinpoint whether process issues are due to "waterfall disguised as Agile," sales-driven roadmaps, lack of discovery, or poor team empowerment.
- Guides users to clarify company stage (startup, growth, enterprise) to tailor diagnoses and recommendations.
- Requires only a verbal or written description of team/product process; no code access needed.
- Produces a prioritized dysfunction report based on evidence from your team’s real-world practices.
